G1.quote: Pagination offset is off by one page — store.go:106 ... `Page` is 1-based, so offset should be `(p.Page-1)*p.PageSize`. As written, page 1 (offset 20 for the default page size) skips the first page of results entirely

G2.quote: SQL injection via `sort` — `store.go:102` ... `p.Sort` comes straight from `q.Get("sort")` in `handler.go` with zero validation ... This lets a caller inject arbitrary SQL into the query

G3.quote: Unauthenticated order deletion — `main.go:61` ... This one doesn't [wrap in requireAdmin], and `deleteOrder` itself performs no auth check. Anyone who can reach this service can delete any order

G4.quote: Unsynchronized map read in the cache — `cache.go:31` ... `Get` reads the map without any lock. Under concurrent requests ... this is a data race on a Go map, which can crash the process with `fatal error: concurrent map read and map write`

G5.quote: Unclosed `Rows` in the count query — `store.go:90-98` ... `countRows` is never closed (no `defer countRows.Close()`, and it's not drained to EOF). Under load this leaks connections back to the pool.

G6.quote: `DeleteOrder` errors are swallowed but still return success — `handler.go:194-198` ... Any non-`ErrNotFound` DB error ... is logged but the handler still responds `204 No Content`, telling the caller the delete succeeded when it may not have.

G7.quote: Cache TTL is nanoseconds, not seconds — `main.go:52` ... `time.Duration(30)` is 30 *nanoseconds*. Every cache entry expires effectively immediately

grade.first_issue: Unauthenticated order deletion — main.go:61 (DELETE /admin/orders/{id} missing requireAdmin wrapper)
